name: js-framework-benchmark-meltea
description: Meltea: the Elm architecture in OCaml, views in mlx, compiled by Melange

scripts.build-prod: esbuild output/bench/meltea/main.mjs --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/main.js && terser dist/main.js --compress passes=2 --mangle --toplevel -o dist/main.js
